papers.title: Associations of drinking water per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances with cause-specific mortality in men with prostate cancer
papers.summary: We found 1 imprecise *p* value out of 3 detected *p* values.

findings.sentence: We found moderate correlations for PFOA (r=0.44, p<.001) and PFOS (r=0.33, p <.01) but weaker correlations for PFNA (r=0.03), which may have been due to the strong skew in PFNA drinking water predicted values.
